cause_mining: B1 sat behind two locks: permit-first (C1 first) and first-row (A1 + C1 learned). A1 needs two routes made, and the only routes that fed a mining player were cluster lanes, which need B1. Points: start gives 1 (home planet), C1 took it, the permit reserve took the next 3. Never reached 5.
change_mining: Chosen: exempt B1 (cost 1) from both locks (SkillTree.FIRST_ROW_FREE). Smallest rule change: no new points, no economy key, no bot change. Alternatives rejected: extra point source (balance key, economy owner), cluster routes granting points (new reward path). Not dominant: B1 first delays C1/permit by one route; sim mining_focus ~ decent (95% vs 91%). B2..B4 stay behind the first row.
cause_deadlock: Real softlock for a human too: cash below one trip fixed cost (e.g. 110) with empty storage. A Buy cannot feed (reserve takes the trip money, 0 left for goods) and the route stalls 'Not enough cash', so nothing can ever earn. Reached by buying a ship down to ~120 cash and running tiny loads at a loss.
change_deadlock: RouteEngine.fare_for(fixed, cash, paid_yet): if cash < fixed and no route has run yet this cycle, the first route flies for the cash left (may be 0); later routes still stall. Used in settle (_settle_one, flag fare_paid) and forecast (fare_seen), so forecast == settle. route_reserve: when no other route reserves, a loaded route short of its trip reserves all remaining cash, so a Buy still cannot spend a running route's money. Reserve for normal cash unchanged. Entering the state costs a Buy-fed bootstrap: at cash < trip + one unit price the Buy may spend freely and the route then flies on a part fare.
files: game/skill_tree.gd (FIRST_ROW_FREE, two gates), game/route_engine.gd (fare_for, fare_paid, route_reserve, _settle_one, forecast). Save format unchanged.
